vocabulary.meaning_en: a co-worker who is hard to work with
vocabulary.example: How do you deal with a difficult colleague?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take action to solve a problem
vocabulary.example: I have to deal with this problem today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to find something very hard to do
vocabulary.example: Anna is struggling to work with Rachel.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make it harder for someone to do something
vocabulary.example: Too many meetings hinder our work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make someone a little angry
vocabulary.example: His loud phone calls annoy everyone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: worried
vocabulary.example: I'm concerned about the deadline.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something done wrongly
vocabulary.note_ar: make a mistake وليس do a mistake.
vocabulary.note_en: Say make a mistake, not do a mistake.
vocabulary.example: She made a mistake in the order.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to change or have an influence on something
vocabulary.note_ar: affect فعل، و effect اسم غالبًا.
vocabulary.note_en: Affect is usually a verb; effect is usually a noun.
vocabulary.example: The delay might affect the business.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do your fair share of the work
vocabulary.example: Everyone in the team must pull their weight.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to send a problem to a more senior person
vocabulary.example: If you can't solve it, refer it up to your manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an opinion about what someone should do
vocabulary.note_ar: advice اسم غير معدود؛ الفعل advise.
vocabulary.note_en: Advice is uncountable; the verb is advise.
vocabulary.example: Ask your boss for advice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a polite way to ask to speak to someone privately
vocabulary.example: Paul, could I have a word, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: keep it secret
vocabulary.example: This is confidential, so keep it under your hat.

vocabulary.meaning_en: giving your own opinion
vocabulary.example: Speaking personally, I think the plan is too expensive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to investigate or examine something
vocabulary.example: I will look into this straight away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: immediately
vocabulary.example: I'll call the client straight away.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to tell someone about a problem so they know about it
vocabulary.example: Thank you for bringing it to my attention.

vocabulary.meaning_en: that is not acceptable
vocabulary.example: Arriving late every day? That's just not on.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to try to find out the facts about something
vocabulary.example: The manager will investigate the problem.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that something is wrong or not good enough
vocabulary.example: You should only complain if you have a fair reason.

vocabulary.meaning_en: moving to a higher job in a company
vocabulary.example: She got a promotion last year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an increase in the money you earn
vocabulary.example: He asked for a pay rise.

fine_lines.title: affect vs effect
fine_lines.explanation_ar: affect فعل بمعنى (يؤثر على)، و effect اسم بمعنى (تأثير / نتيجة). تذكّر: A = Action (فعل)، E = End result (نتيجة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Affect is a verb (to influence). Effect is a noun (the result). Remember: A for action, E for end result.

examples.sentence: This mistake might affect the business.
The new rule had a good effect.

fine_lines.title: advice vs advise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: advice اسم غير معدود (نصيحة) ويُنطق بصوت s، و advise فعل (ينصح) ويُنطق بصوت z.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Advice is an uncountable noun (said with an s sound). Advise is the verb (said with a z sound).

examples.sentence: Can I ask you for some advice?
I advise you to talk to your manager.

expressions.phrase: I'm concerned that she's made a mistake that might affect the business.
expressions.meaning_ar: أنا قلق من أنها ارتكبت خطأً قد يؤثّر على العمل.
expressions.meaning_en: Telling your manager about a worrying mistake.
expressions.example: I'm concerned that he's made a mistake that might affect the business.

expressions.meaning_ar: إنها لا تقوم بنصيبها من العمل.
expressions.meaning_en: She isn't doing her fair share of work.
expressions.example: The team is unhappy because one member is not pulling his weight.

expressions.phrase: I'm finding it very difficult to work with her.
expressions.meaning_ar: أجد صعوبة كبيرة في العمل معها.
expressions.meaning_en: Explaining a problem with a colleague.
expressions.example: I'm finding it very difficult to work with him.

expressions.phrase: Could I have a word, please?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني التحدث معك قليلًا من فضلك؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking to speak to someone privately.
expressions.example: Paul, could I have a word, please?

expressions.phrase: I will look into this straight away.
expressions.example: Thank you. I will look into this straight away.

expressions.phrase: Thank you for bringing it to my attention.
expressions.meaning_ar: شكرًا لأنك لفتّ انتباهي إلى هذا الأمر.
expressions.meaning_en: Thanking someone for reporting a problem.
expressions.example: Thank you for bringing it to my attention. I'll deal with it.
He hasn't done any work all week? That's just not on.

grammar.title: Present continuous for situations happening now: I'm finding…
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع المستمر (am/is/are + ing) لوصف وضع يحدث الآن وقد يستمر، مثل الشعور بالصعوبة: I'm finding it difficult. و She's not pulling her weight.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing) for a situation happening around now: I'm finding it difficult. She's not pulling her weight.
examples: I'm finding it very difficult to work with her.
Anna is struggling to work with Rachel.

grammar.title: I'm concerned that… + present perfect
grammar.explanation_ar: للتعبير عن القلق بلغة رسمية نقول I'm concerned that + جملة. ونستخدم المضارع التام لخطأ وقع وما زالت نتيجته قائمة: she's made a mistake.
grammar.explanation_en: To express worry formally say 'I'm concerned that + clause'. Use the present perfect for a mistake with a result now: she's made a mistake.
examples: I'm concerned that she's made a mistake.
I'm concerned that we've lost the client.
I'm concerned that the order hasn't arrived.

grammar.title: might for possibility
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم might + الفعل لاحتمال غير مؤكد: might affect the business (قد يؤثر).
grammar.explanation_en: Use might + base verb for something that is possible but not certain.
examples: The mistake might affect the business.
The client might cancel the order.

questions.question: 'She's not pulling her weight' means…
choices: she's not doing her share of the work
questions.explanation_ar: pull your weight تعني القيام بنصيبك من العمل.
questions.explanation_en: It means doing your fair share of the work.

questions.question: Complete: 'I'm ___ that she's made a mistake that might affect the business.'
Choose the correct word: 'This mistake might ___ the business.'
How do you politely ask your boss to speak privately?
choices: Could I have a word, please?
questions.explanation_ar: Could I have a word? طريقة مهذبة لطلب الحديث.
questions.explanation_en: 'Could I have a word?' is the polite way.

questions.question: Paul says 'I will look into this.' What does he mean?
choices: He will look out of the window.
questions.explanation_ar: look into تعني يحقق في الأمر.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
choices: Can you give me an advice?
Can you give me some advice?
Can you give me some advices?
Can you advice me some help?
questions.explanation_ar: advice اسم غير معدود فلا نقول an advice ولا advices.
questions.explanation_en: Advice is uncountable: no 'an', no plural.

questions.question: 'Refer up' a problem means…
choices: take it to a more senior person
questions.explanation_ar: refer up تعني رفع المشكلة إلى مسؤول أعلى.
questions.explanation_en: It means passing it to a more senior person.

questions.question: Complete: 'I'm ___ it very difficult to work with her.'
'That's just not on' means…
questions.explanation_ar: التعبير يعني أن الأمر غير مقبول.
questions.explanation_en: It means that is not acceptable.
